capabilities.scope: One Nano variant booted PLUTO_NANO_RX from a RAM-only FIT with its original FPGA image and an FFS RAM root. QSPI installation and other revisions remain unqualified.

Finite RX1 IQ capture and one 1160-center sweep from 325 MHz to 3.8 GHz returned zero on the recorded configuration. TX stayed inhibited. This is not RF calibration, continuous streaming or antenna qualification.
The separate USB-C CH340 UART provided the EmberBSD PS UART1 console at 115200 8N1. Hardware BREAK was not a verified debugger entry. This does not qualify the data USB port under EmberBSD.

One Nano variant completed 1978 finite capture centers from 70 MHz to 6 GHz with explicit RX-only FDT opt-in. Actual AD9363 identity and the 20 MHz RF bandwidth limit remain. PLL checks and TX inhibition passed; analog performance outside the qualified 325–3800 MHz band remains uncalibrated.
